model: imageomics/bioclip ViT-B/16 image encoder, ONNX opset 17, 4-bit weight-only (MatMulNBits, block 16, asymmetric), fp32 activations
note: Weight-only quantisation keeps activations in float, so the same photo always gives the same answer and tiny pixel changes no longer move the result (the earlier dynamic uint8 model re-quantised every activation per image).
